modules.name: tb_road_result_publish_joint
modules.description: Actual-ROM decode/TopK/NMS to SRIF1 publisher and source/pending/active table verification.

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Common reset cancels head, candidate RAM, NMS, shared LUT, actual reader, publisher, table and time snapshot together.

behavior: Streams all 12096 saved HEAD112 cells through the unchanged 56-lane PH1P true-G10 reader and shared LUT, internal candidate RAM, TopK and NMS.
NMS FINAL97 flows through the publisher into C8 source storage; no fourth functional result table exists. Golden testbench arrays compare every active bit and all metadata fields.
Accepted start freezes context; mutations during busy cannot change epoch/task/source_frame/model/capture. Completion is the same source time sampled on successful NMS done.
Source metadata acceptance, copy acknowledgement and normal destination SOF active events are separate timestamps. Their intervals are disjoint; internal waits are contained diagnostics.
Normal modes use actual 100MHz millisecond snapshot and template 75MHz SOF period. Controlled coherent time boundary mode explicitly does not measure real FPS.
constraints: AGE_LIMIT_MS=2000 only in new candidate; existing 500 baseline remains unchanged.
No CNN inference, camera capture identity binding, DDR, synthesis, physical timing, deployment or board evidence is claimed.
Only a different completed source_frame_id counts as a new detection result; retaining active data is not an additional result.
corner_cases: empty, seven and64 outputs including6944 comparisons
partial fault and abort; common reset; post-seal cancel ignored until copy_ack
raw age1996 and1997; unknown and lost time; one-second controlled identity updates
verification_cases: Actual vendor ROM full numerical regression plus publisher/C8 all97-bit active and265-bit metadata checks.
No simultaneous last-entry/metadata transfer, held metadata stable until ready, no half table, start blocked until copy_ack.
Real snapshot loss watchdog and separate controlled coherent age/one-second group.

timing_diagrams.title: Complete result source to active
timing_diagrams.description: Last entry, NMS done, metadata acceptance, destination copy acknowledgement and later SOF active update occur in order.
